post.summary: Opt-in paid complete thumbnail from one to four photographs
post.description: People and photographic material must come solely from the supplied one to four source photographs. No invented people or combined faces; same person appears once. Previous outputs and style references are not material sources. Legacy single-photo generation remains 0.10.2 and legacy two-/three-photo generation remains 0.11.0. These are prompt constraints, not automatic output verification. JSON body at most 36MiB; one paid edit, no automatic retry. Required-reference generation 0.12.1 asks for minimal photo processing, original skin/camera softness and typography/composition-only reference use; requested whole-photo panels override forced cutout recipes. This remains a prompt constraint, not pixel-identical compositing. Four-photo generation uses 0.13.0; up to three photographs may accompany the main photograph. Other photo counts retain their versions and natural-photo rules.

brief.description: Optional video content notes. Omitted, empty or whitespace-only normalizes to an empty string; title and photograph are enough in automatic-headline mode. No missing video facts should be invented.

headline.description: Required nonempty text in manual mode. In auto mode omit this field or send null/empty; actual rendered wording is not extracted.

headlineMode.description: Omitted retains the existing manual-headline API behavior. Auto asks the image model to choose one concise, supported reason to watch from the video title and optional brief, preserving the title language rather than replacing a story with an isolated topic word. This happens in the same paid image-edit call. Actual wording is not extracted or verified.

design.description: Art-direction intent. photo_focus requests a lower caption in upright humanist sans-serif over the full photo; editorial requests an upper headline in upright serif/Mincho; impact requests a large side headline in condensed bold sans-serif. Explicit composition overrides the default headline zone. In generation 0.8.0, a normal edit with both design and composition auto includes a versioned bank of nine conditional typography/placement relationships for the image model to compare against the actual photo, headline and atmosphere in the same call. Manual design or composition and revisions do not receive those competing candidates. No reference images or video wording are uploaded. This is not a rotation, measured pattern selection or proof of quality; actual fonts, layout and selected pattern remain unverified. In generation 0.9.0, opt-in recompose permits isolating, cropping, scaling and repositioning people, objects and scene portions already visible in the original photograph. Source scenery or a neutral graphic backdrop may be used; preserve identity, expression, pose, skin, clothing and object shapes. Do not invent people, objects, locations or activities or duplicate a person. Other designs retain whole-photo preservation. From generation 0.9.1, an initial recompose explicitly requires at least one source person, coherent group or object to be isolated and moved or resized relative to the backdrop; a whole-photo crop, palette change or text overlay alone is insufficient. Whole-scene reference layout candidates are excluded from recompose. This is an instruction, not verified evidence that the operation occurred. Revisions keep their requested design and do not receive competing reference layouts. This is an image-editing request, not pixel-identical segmentation, measured regions, layers or proof of quality.

visualIntent.description: Optional requested atmosphere, e.g. calm everyday travel. The model chooses composition and typography in the same image edit; this is not a selected or measured layout. Omitted or whitespace-only means infer from title and brief. Explicit design/composition constraints still apply.

composition.description: Optional composition intent for the photo edit. Omitted means photo-aware automatic composition. Preservation and exact layout still require visual checking.

revision.description: Optional revision: original photograph stays authoritative; previous completed PNG is a typography/layout reference. One paid edit produces one new PNG.

imageDataUrl.description: 1536x864 PNG; binary at most 16MiB, data URL at most 22,369,646 characters. Decoded byte length is also validated.

feedback.description: Optional. User-selected local review snapshot; reasons are sent as historical data, never as current instructions or extra headline text. No old photo bytes are included. Current constraints take priority.

referenceMode.description: Optional verified reference library, omitted/off retains legacy behavior; editor defaults auto. Code shortlists up to 5 visually recorded examples by text tags and material, not source-photo analysis. Image model checks feasibility in the same edit. Raw reference images only with recorded permission; otherwise generic observations only. Revisions/manual art direction skip retrieval. No model training or measured selection. required is the normal editor path: a nonblank visualIntent and a pool of 100 fresh, visually observed references are mandatory; unavailable libraries stop before paid dispatch. Omitted/off/auto preserve historical API behavior.

additionalImageDataUrls.description: Optional additional source photographs in order, at most three. Each is a distinct 1280x720 PNG data URL of at most 3MiB. Empty or omitted keeps the single-photo path. All supplied source photos are authoritative; each is uploaded as a separate image[] before revision/style references. Duplicate decoded bytes are rejected before provider dispatch.

revision.description: Present only for a revision. ID echoed from the request and SHA-256 calculated over the previous PNG bytes; matching against a stored parent image is a separate check.

feedbackApplied.description: Present only when feedback was supplied. Echo of the normalized context added to the prompt, not evidence that the output followed it.

validationA.description: Server-side fixed-input check, not an image-quality judgement. New comparison exports preserve this receipt and recheck its source/request hashes; imported JSON is not a signed attestation.

additionalSourceSha256s.description: Ordered additional source hashes for a multi-photo fixed input, omitted on single-photo receipts.

sourcePhotoSha256s.description: Present only for multiple source photographs. SHA-256 of the main and additional PNG bytes in exact upload order. This records input identity, not output preservation.

409.description: VALIDATION_A_MISMATCH: 固定入力または実行版の不一致。生成しない。

429.description: Concurrent request or shared call limit

503.description: Missing key, disabled paid requests or provider auth REFERENCE_LIBRARY_INCOMPLETE: required pool has fewer than 100 fresh visual observations; no provider call.

parameters.name: X-Validation-A-Case
parameters.description: A検証の固定ID。入力・実行コード・モデル設定を照合し、不一致やfeedback/revisionは有料呼び出し前に拒否する。

post.description: Local PNG diagnostics, not a quality Assessment. Maximum 4 referenced assets, 16MiB per PNG, 32MiB combined, 45MiB JSON. Integrity/reference errors return 400; corrupt or unsupported PNGs return 200 with status unavailable. Source photos are never treated as text-free backgrounds. Does not call external APIs or consume generation quota.

200.description: Diagnostics, including explicit unavailable results. No quality score.

400.description: Invalid asset input, reference, hash, length or JSON

post.description: ローカルの無料処理。写真と入力を検証し、実行コードのハッシュ・生成設定・同条件のChatGPT依頼文を返す。外部送信・保存・有料生成は行わない。consent、feedback、revisionは受け付けない。入力上限14MiB。 2〜3枚写真はcase 1.1.0で全写真の順序・ハッシュを固定し、正式な1枚写真のA比較とは分ける。 4枚写真はcase1.2.0、source-4.pngまで保存する。

get.description: Private local catalog. Metadata and cached images expire after 30 days; expiration deletes them on next access. Refresh uses YouTube Data API, never OpenAI. Language/region are search preferences, not verified Japanese-language labels.

200.description: Catalog with separate qualified/visually observed/permission counts

post.description: Bounded metadata search: rolling six calendar months, strictly more than 1,000,000 views, duration >=240s, nonlive, maximum 5/channel, target 100. Refreshes existing metadata. Up to 24 searches per run; results need not be a global top 100. No image generation, secret returned or threshold relaxation.

post.description: Free text-tag shortlist; no source photograph supplied, generation, or OpenAI request.

sourcePhotoCount.description: Source photo count only; no source image bytes are sent to this free preview. Multiple sources use the same material preference as generation.

get.description: Fetch allowlisted YouTube thumbnail, validate PNG/JPEG header and dimensions, cache privately by SHA-256, max 2MiB. No redirects, video downloads or OpenAI calls. Changed hashes invalidate observations and permission.

200.description: Image bytes; X-Thumbnail-SHA256 identifies this exact cached image

title.description: Trimmed, 1–60 Unicode code points; no control characters.

Assessment.description: レイアウトの仮説的な指標（採点0.4.0）。CTR予測や効果保証ではない。未評価の項目は null で、0点とは区別する。

overall.description: 未評価の項目を0点とみなした総合点（下限）。評価済み項目の値×重みの合計を四捨五入。

overallMax.description: 未評価の項目を満点とみなした総合点（上限）。すべて評価済みなら overall と同じ。統計的な信頼区間やCTR予測ではない。

coverage.description: 評価できた項目の重みの合計（%）。

unevaluated.description: 未評価（metricsがnull）の項目名。contrast, brevity, font, fit の順。すべて評価済みなら空配列。候補のグループ分けに使う。

weights.description: 総合点の重み（%、合計100）。仮説で未校正。

contrast.description: タイトル文字と背面のコントラスト。タイトルの全行の背面が単色（solid）と確認できた場合だけ評価。

font.description: 文字サイズのみ（48px以上で満点＝検証前の仮値）。

fit.description: 配置領域への収まり。タイトルの全行が測定済み（rendered/estimated、寸法あり、正常値）の場合だけ評価。

keyConfigured.description: Only whether a key is present; never the key itself

additionalSourcePhotoAssetIds.description: Ordered additional source_photo asset IDs. Must be present in assets, distinct from primary and each other; requires image-assets-1.1.0.
Ordered additional source_photo asset IDs. Must be present in assets, distinct from primary and each other; requires image-assets-1.1.0.

GenerationFeedback.description: Frozen historical review snapshot used only as context in the same paid image edit. No model training or Assessment update. Runtime also checks unique group/image IDs, selected-image membership, meaningful reasons/issues, parseable dates, criteria derived from issue tags, and serialized size <=24,000 characters. SHA references are supplied provenance, not server-verified access to historical assets. New generation requests reject every holdout group: SHA-256 of the complete groupId string, first byte <77 is holdout. Historical snapshots are retained unchanged by archive import. Reviewer IDs must match ^r[0-9]{2,}$.

chatgptPrompt.description: For new A cases, the ordinary short ChatGPT request from PR #11, sharing source photo and content inputs without copying internal service rules. Historical detailed requests remain readable as reference-only comparisons.

referenceAssets.description: Only actually sent, permission-confirmed reference assets. Runtime verifies count, candidate hash links, ZIP path, byte length and SHA-256.

additionalSources.description: Ordered source-2.png, source-3.png and source-4.png. Case1.1.0 has one or two extra sources; case1.2.0 has three. Runtime verifies exact path ordering and distinct hashes.

ThumbnailReferenceContext.description: Supplied candidates are not evidence of the model's chosen layout or improved output. No API view/date statistics copied to long-lived generation results. Version 1.1.0 binds the 100-example considered pool and normalized atmosphere by SHA-256. Only shortlisted generic observations and permission-approved images are supplied; no training or output-quality claim.

ReferenceObservationInput.description: Generic visual observations, not human preference labels. Permission basis required when generationAllowed=true. Saves only against the current cached thumbnail hash; mismatches return 409.
